After their allies violently attack, chieftain Dineru of the dark elves commands her remaining people to flee, leading them into Orcsen, a land of orcs. Despite being enemies, Dineru and her clan are welcomed into the kingdom. Dineru makes a deal with the orc king, Gustav, asking for supplies so she can return to fight, but Gustav has other plans. Fighting alongside the dark elves, Gustav helps lead Dineru to victory and offers them a permanent home in the kingdom. Will Dineru and her people find peace, or is this the beginning of a deadly future? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: Riding in a camper, eating delicious food, and enjoying the spectacular view. Saori Furuki was a university student in the engineering department and loved making things. After a car accident, she is reborn as Eline, the daughter of a viscount, However, her family treats her coldly, saying that she is incompetent and can only use magic to produce items, and she is exiled from the country. However, Eline's “alchemy magic” is a magic that has unlimited possibilities when combined with the knowledge from her previous life! Determined to live freely from now on, Eline has created a camper for starters. She can move around, live, and make things as she pleases. Together with Aristy, a martial maid who adores Eline, she begins her adventurous journey with a sense of ease. Eating delicious food, admiring the spectacular scenery, and creating useful things. This is a travel story about riding in a camper and enjoying another world with elegance. (Source: SB Creative, translated)

When she visits Seki's apartment, a half-naked, scary-looking man comes out... but for some reason, he immediately starts doting on her!? He's frivolous and overly affectionate... but she just can't hate him. (Source: Kodansha, translated)

titleNative: 何の取り柄もない平凡な俺が美人双子姉妹を命懸けで助けた結果、実はヤンデレだった二人をガチ惚れさせてしまった件
synonyms: I, an Ordinary Guy with No Redeeming Qualities, Risked My Life to Save Beautiful Twin Sisters, Only to Make the Secretly Yandere Duo Fall Madly in Love with Me
synopsis: Yagami Ryoya, an ordinary high school boy with no particular redeeming qualities, saved the lives of the school's idol twin sisters from a violent thug. That was the beginning of their sweet yet abnormal "repayment"─. Reona and Riona close the distance, affirming his every move and spoiling him to the absolute limit. However, their love is a "yandere" obsession that goes way beyond just being "super heavy"...!? Dragging in his family, his environment, and everything else around him, the twin sisters completely seal off Ryoya's escape routes. They are undeniably cute, but there is nowhere to run. What will become of Ryoya's fate now that he is locked onto by a 100% pure desire for monopoly!? Packed with lovey-dovey moments! An unpredictable romantic comedy where the protagonist gets completely tossed around, officially begins!
